# fptcloud_backup_veeam_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the backup jobs of the Backup Veeam service in a VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_vpc" "this" {
  name = "your_vpc_name"
}

data "fptcloud_backup_veeam_jobs" "all" {
  vpc_id = data.fptcloud_vpc.this.id
}

output "job_names" {
  value = [for job in data.fptcloud_backup_veeam_jobs.all.jobs : job.name]
}

# status reflects the last synchronisation with Veeam, not a real-time value.
output "job_status" {
  value = {
    for job in data.fptcloud_backup_veeam_jobs.all.jobs : job.name => job.status
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC to list backup jobs from.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return jobs whose name matches this value.
- `status` (String) Only return jobs with this status.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jobs` (List of Object) The backup jobs found in the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))
